scope.zh: 植入先进知识行动终结：5个文档。

texts.zh: 我们的特工已尽其所能，将各种细小的技术进步播撒到[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]社会。现在就看当地人如何连点成线，把量变转化成质变。他们已经做好了一切准备。
texts.en: Our operatives have done all they can, seeding various small technological advances into [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] society. It is up to the locals now to connect the dots, and assemble these small steps into a larger one. They are as ready as they'll ever be.

texts.zh: 成功了！我们向[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]社会播撒的科技和知识蓬勃发展，从内部大大推进了他们的文明。只有时间才能说明由此可能产生的长期影响，但目前我们的特工报告说，[from.target.capital_scope.GetName]相当繁荣，善意空前。
texts.en: Success! The technology and knowledge we sowed into [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] society has flourished, greatly advancing their civilization from within. Only time will tell what long-term impacts this may have, but for now our operatives report a great deal of good will and prosperity down on [from.target.capital_scope.GetName].

texts.zh: 我们的特工从[from.target.capital_scope.GetName]传来捷报！我们向[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]社会播撒的科技和知识已开花结果，推动他们的文明向星系进发。只有时间才能说明由此可能产生的长期影响，但目前我们的特工报告说，[from.owner.GetPreFTLLower]星球的繁荣程度有所提高。
texts.en: Our operatives report good results on [from.target.capital_scope.GetName]! The technology and knowledge we sowed into [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] society has borne fruit, nudging their civilization closer towards galactic involvement. Only time will tell what long-term impacts this may have, but for now our operatives report increased prosperity on the [from.owner.GetPreFTLLower] world.

texts.zh: 我们启迪[from.target.capital_scope.GetName]居民的行动取得了部分成功。尽管遇到了一些挫折，我们还是促进了一些基础的科技进步，确信[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]社会终会腾飞。不过他们的文明也许不会如我们此前希望的那样迅速或顺利地发展到星际层次。
texts.en: We have partially succeeded in enlightening the residents of [from.target.capital_scope.GetName]. Despite some setbacks, we have nevertheless encouraged some basic technological progress and are confident that [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] society will eventually flourish. However, their civilization may not reach the stars quite as quickly or as smoothly as we had initially hoped.

texts.zh: 我们的特工报告说，启迪[from.target.capital_scope.GetName]居民的行动圆满成功。我们传播给[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]社会的科技和知识已经生根发芽，推动他们的文明在通往星海的道路上更进一步。
texts.en: Our operatives report a successful conclusion in our efforts to enlighten the residents of [from.target.capital_scope.GetName]. The technology and knowledge we introduced to [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] society have taken root, bringing their civilization a little closer towards reaching the stars.

# [from.GetName]：准备就绪 / [from.GetName]: Ready
- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 间谍行动结局（前FTL）pre-FTL espionage operation finale
- 来源 Sources：`events/first_contact_dlc_operations_events.txt:552-767` · `common/espionage_operation_types/pre_ftl_operations.txt:300-448` · `common/scripted_effects/espionage_event_effects.txt:2840-2906` · `common/scripted_effects/first_contact_dlc_effects.txt:3093-3130`
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（c7b-society）

## 如何开始 How it starts

玩家对前FTL文明发动“植入先进知识”行动（`operation_plant_advanced_knowledge`，`pre_ftl_operations.txt:300-448`），完成最后一章后触发本事件。行动章节：每个针对前FTL文明的间谍行动由 3–4 个章节组成，前几章触发隐藏占位事件 preftl_operation.100，最后一章触发本事件。章节检定失败时（pre_ftl_espionage_operation_on_roll_failed，`espionage_event_effects.txt:2840–2906`），有 10/400 的概率（无“外貌改造”科技时 ×1.5；同一行动 120 天内最多一次）从随机事件池抽取插曲（3000–3105）；插曲的选项会改变行动的成功度变量 pre_ftl_operation_success（±1/±2），最终事件按该变量选择结果档：>2 极佳，>0 良好，=0 标准，<0 糟糕（`first_contact_dlc_effects.txt:3093–3130`）。 / The player runs the “Plant Advanced Knowledge” operation (operation_plant_advanced_knowledge) against a pre-FTL country; completing its last chapter fires this event. Operation chapters: each espionage operation against a pre-FTL country has 3–4 chapters; the early ones fire the hidden placeholder preftl_operation.100 and the last one fires this event. When a chapter roll fails there is a 10-in-400 chance (×1.5 without the appearance-modding tech; at most once per 120 days per operation) to draw an interlude (3000–3105); interlude options change the success variable pre_ftl_operation_success (±1 / ±2). The finale then picks an outcome tier: >2 great, >0 good, =0 standard, <0 poor.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

**就绪（1045）**→ **1046 一大步**（极佳）/ **1047 相当大的一步**（良好）/ **1048 稳步前进**（标准）/ **1049 挫折**（糟糕）；成功档位推动对方科技进度。 / Ready (1045) → 1046 (great), 1047 (good), 1048 (standard), 1049 (poor); better tiers advance the target’s technology.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

极佳/良好/标准/糟糕四档互斥：1046（>2）、1047（>0）、1048（=0）、1049（<0）。/ Four exclusive tiers: great 1046, good 1047, standard 1048, poor 1049.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

结局文本因观察者类型（普通/蜂巢/机械）、目标是否前工业时代而异。/ Text varies with the owner type and the target’s era.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：终结事件、行动类型、成功度判定与对应章节定义。/ Finale, operation type, success rule and chapter definitions.
- 审阅改动 Changes：原编译草稿结构正确；补充了行动背景、成功度规则与各档位。/ The compiled structure was correct; operation background, the success rule and tiers added.
